The evidence suggests that (+)-Secoisolariciresinol diglucoside may act through a series of intermediate targets that ultimately converge on Gamma-secretase, potentially modulating its activity. The strength of the evidence is supported by multiple independent pathways, though the exact mechanism of interaction remains to be elucidated.
